# Veil 0.17.0

Minor version update for all ten Veil, Shield Swap, and Bridge packages.

## Changes

- Add the Node-only Aleo account keystore with plaintext, password-encrypted,
  macOS Keychain, and address-only storage. Account helpers support loading,
  inspection, protection changes, export, and migration from legacy state files.
- Add `shield-swap account` commands and use the shared account keystore for
  CLI setup and signing. New state files store the account name and address.
- Add exact-amount, exact-liquidity, and amount-driven rebalance helpers and
  planners, including token caps, minimums, funding budgets, and refunds.
  The `rebalance` CLI command produces a plan by default.
- Add `shield-swap version`, `--version`, and `-v`, plus `shield-swap update`
  for global npm installations with read-only update checks and JSON output.

## Dependencies and toolchain

| Component | Version |
| --- | --- |
| `@provablehq/sdk` and `@provablehq/wasm` | 0.13.1, using snarkVM 4.13.1 |
| Leo in CI | 4.4.6 |
| `@provablehq/aleo-devnode` | 0.4.0, unchanged and current |
| Wallet adapter core | 1.3.1 |
| React wallet adapter | 1.5.1 |
| Shield wallet adapter | 1.6.0 |
| Leo, Puzzle, and Fox wallet adapters | 1.1.5 |
| `@provablehq/aleo-types` for wallet integrations | 1.3.0 |
| `@provablehq/aleo-wallet-standard` | 1.6.0 |

## Compatibility

Existing CLI state files containing a private key continue to work; use
`shield-swap account migrate` to move the key into the account keystore.
Environment-supplied keys are used for the current run and are no longer
copied into state files. Earlier CLI versions cannot load sessions from the
new state-file format.

Existing exact-quote rebalance calls remain supported. Bridge and Shield Swap
retain their `@provablehq/sdk` peer range of `^0.13.0`, which also accepts
0.13.1.

Peer ranges for `veil-core` and `veil-aleo-devnode` move to `>=0.17.0 <1.0.0`.
`@provablehq/veil-aleo-sdk` 0.17.0 imports an export that `veil-core` adds in
this release, so the two must be upgraded together.
